SOFTWARE_INSTALL: Check if you have admin rights to install software.
Download the latest installer from the official website.
Disable antivirus temporarily if it blocks the installation.
Restart your computer and try again.
If you see an error message, copy/paste it here.
WIFI_ISSUE: Turn Wi-Fi off/on and re-join the network.
Check if other devices on the same Wi-Fi work.
Forget the Wi-Fi network and reconnect.
Move closer to the router to check signal strength.
VPN_ISSUE: Confirm internet works without VPN first.
Sign out/in of the VPN app, then reconnect.
If there’s an error code, paste it exactly.
Try a different network (e.g., mobile hotspot).
Check if your VPN subscription or credentials are valid.
OUTLOOK_ISSUE: Check Outlook Web (OWA) to see if it’s account vs app.
If it shows an error, copy/paste it.
Remove and re-add your email account in Outlook.
Check for Outlook or Office updates.
PRINTER_ISSUE: Clear the print queue and try a test page.
Share printer model + exact error text.
Check if the printer is connected to the correct network.
Ensure printer drivers are up to date.
PASSWORD_RESET: Try the self-service reset portal (if your org has it).
If MFA fails, check your phone time sync and try again.
Contact IT support if you are locked out.
Make sure you are using the correct username.
SLOW_COMPUTER: Restart and check top CPU/RAM apps (Task Manager / Activity Monitor).
Make sure you have free disk space (10–20% free is nice).
Close unused applications and browser tabs.
UNKNOWN: Tell me what you were trying to do when it failed.
Copy/paste the exact error text (if any).
Describe the steps you took before the issue occurred.
Let me know if this is urgent or blocking your work.
